Keyboard Controls

Keyboard: Q / E rudder. Controller: left stick pitch/turn, right stick rudder, LT throttle down/brake, RT throttle up, A camera, X nav, Y +3 hours, Menu/Options menu, View/Share restart. Replay: A/Cross skip, X/Square camera, D-pad left/right speed. Touch replay controls appear on-screen. VR controls are shown in-headset.

AeroCrash

Browser aircraft physics sandbox built with Three.js and WebXR.

Menu music: prettyjohn1 — Chill Chill Music. Flights use aircraft, wind, runway, weather and crash SFX only — no flight music.

Designed for keyboard, touch, standard gamepads and supported WebXR headsets.
